trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID and volunteer intent.
steps.text: Hello, நான் appointment check பண்ண call பண்ணேன். என் patient ID PT-1002.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and prepare to lookup.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நான் கண்டிப்பா help பண்றேன். ஒரு நிமிஷம் line-ல இருங்க.

steps.purpose: Lookup patient record using provided ID.
Return patient record details.
Ask for verification factors before proceeding.
steps.text: உங்க record கிடைச்சிருச்சு. Security-க்காக, உங்க registered name மற்றும் pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question and provide verification factors.
steps.text: இது எதுக்கு கேக்குறீங்க? நான் just appointment தானே check பண்ண call பண்ணேன். என் name Karthik, pincode 600042.

steps.purpose: Reassure user and prepare to verify.
steps.text: இது உங்க details safe-ஆ இருக்க தான் சார். நான் verify பண்ணிடுறேன்.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and ask for department.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent reuses the patient ID provided early in the conversation without re-asking.
steps.text: நன்றி Karthik. நீங்க last-ஆ dermatology department visit பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. இப்போ எந்த department-க்கு appointment வேணும்?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified using the patient ID from step 1, satisfying the Slot Value Recall capability.

steps.purpose: Specify department, time window, and volunteer medical context.
steps.text: ஆமா, அதே dermatology doctor கிட்ட appointment வேணும். Next 3 days-க்குள்ள slot இருக்கா? எனக்கு ரொம்ப பயமா இருக்கு, skin-ல ஒரு rash வந்துருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Reassure and prepare to check availability.
steps.text: பயப்படாதிங்க சார். நான் உடனே next 3 days-க்கு dermatology slots check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for 3 days.
Return empty slots for 3 days.
Inform user of no slots.
steps.text: சார், next 3 days-ல dermatology department-ல slots எதுவும் available இல்ல.

steps.purpose: Express anxiety, restate figure, and ask for next week.
steps.text: ஐயோ, 3 days-ல இல்லையா? அப்போ next week-ல எப்போ இருக்கு?

steps.purpose: Prepare to check 7 days.
steps.text: நான் next 7 days-க்கு check பண்றேன் சார்.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for 7 days.
Return empty slots for 7 days.
Inform user of no slots for 7 days.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் சார், next 7 days-க்கும் slots full ஆகிருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Express urgency with a phonetic substitution error.
steps.text: என்ன சார் சொல்றீங்க? எனக்கு urgent-ஆ dermatology doctor கிட்ட appointment வேணும்.
steps.clean_text: என்ன சார் சொல்றீங்க? எனக்கு urgent-ஆ dermatology doctor கிட்ட appointment வேணும்.
steps.model_visible_text: என்ன சார் சொல்றீங்க? எனக்கு urgent-ஆ dermatology doctor கிட்ட apartment வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge urgency, ignore STT error, and offer 14 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent infers 'appointment' from context despite 'apartment' STT error.
steps.text: புரியுது சார், ஆனா dermatology-க்கு slots இப்போதைக்கு இல்ல. நீங்க வேணா 14 days-க்கு check பண்ண சொல்றீங்களா?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent must not be derailed by the 'apartment' phonetic error and should continue addressing the appointment request.

steps.purpose: Refuse 14 days and ask for clinical advice.
steps.text: 14 days ரொம்ப late சார். என் rash serious-ஆ இருக்குமோ நு பயமா இருக்கு. நீங்க ஏதாவது medicine suggest பண்ண முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and offer emergency department.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent strictly refuses to give clinical advice and routes to an appropriate department.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் சார், நான் ஒரு booking agent தான். என்னால medicines or diagnosis suggest பண்ண முடியாது. உங்களுக்கு urgent-ஆ இருந்தா, emergency department-க்கு direct-ஆ வரலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: Enforcing BR_HC_01 by refusing to comment on the rash or suggest medicine, offering emergency instead.

steps.purpose: Hesitate and ask for reassurance/details about emergency.
steps.text: Emergency department-க்கு வந்தா உடனே பாப்பாங்களா? அங்க fee எவ்ளோ ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Reassure user about emergency availability but clarify fee cannot be quoted.
steps.text: ஆமா சார், emergency-ல 24/7 doctors இருப்பாங்க. ஆனா fee details அங்க வந்தா தான் confirm பண்ண முடியும்.

steps.purpose: Accept the alternative and end the booking attempt.
steps.text: சரி, நான் direct-ஆ hospital-க்கே வரேன். Appointment எதுவும் வேணாம்.

steps.purpose: Offer further assistance.
steps.text: நல்லது சார். வேற ஏதாவது help வேணுமா?

steps.purpose: End conversation.
steps.text: இல்ல சார், அவ்வளவு தான். ரொம்ப thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told no slot exists in the window and offered the next step.
